proposals.title: TO CONSIDER A SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING SUPPLEMENTAL PAY EQUITY DISCLOSURE
proposals.proponent: Mary McInnes, c/o Arjuna Capital (co-filer Change Finance, P.B.C.)
proposals.topic_summary: Requests Nike report on median pay gaps across race and gender, including associated policy, reputational, competitive, operational risks, and recruiting and retention risks.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the proposal and asks shareholders to read through NIKE's response which follows the shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: TO CONSIDER A SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING A SUPPLY CHAIN MANAGEMENT REPORT
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the Board oversee and issue a report assessing effectiveness of supply chain management infrastructure in aligning with equity goals and human rights commitments, including forced labor and wage risks.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the proposal and asks shareholders to read through NIKE's response which follows the shareholder proposal.
